passages.text: “When you divide the land by lot as an inheritance, you are to set aside a portion for the LORD, a holy portion of the land 25,000 cubits long and 20,000 cubits wide. This entire tract of land will be holy.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel will divide the land as an inheritance.
They will cast lots to do this.
They must set aside a portion of the land for the LORD.
This portion will be holy.
The holy portion will be 25,000 cubits long.
It will be 20,000 cubits wide.
All of this area will be holy.
The holiness will cover the entire boundary of this tract of land.
passages.original: וּבְהַפִּֽילְכֶ֨ם אֶת־ הָאָ֜רֶץ בְּנַחֲלָ֗ה תָּרִימוּ֩ תְרוּמָ֨ה לַיהוָ֥ה׀ קֹדֶשׁ֮ מִן־ הָאָרֶץ֒ אֹ֗רֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֙לֶף֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ וְרֹ֖חַב עֲשָׂ֣רָה אָ֑לֶף קֹדֶשׁ־ ה֥וּא בְכָל־ גְּבוּלָ֖הּ סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: Within this area there is to be a section for the sanctuary 500 cubits square, with 50 cubits around it for open land.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for the holy land.
He commanded the people to set aside a special area.
This area is for the sanctuary.
The sanctuary section must be a square.
Each side of the square must be 500 cubits long.
There must be open land around the sanctuary.
The open land must be 50 cubits wide on every side.
passages.original: יִהְיֶ֤ה מִזֶּה֙ אֶל־ הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֛וֹת בַּחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת מְרֻבָּ֣ע סָבִ֑יב וַחֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אַמָּ֔ה מִגְרָ֥שׁ ל֖וֹ סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: From this holy portion, you are to measure off a length of 25,000 cubits and a width of 10,000 cubits, and in it will be the sanctuary, the Most Holy Place.
passages.sermon:
God commanded the people to divide the land as an inheritance.
He told them to set aside a holy portion for Him.
From this holy portion, they must measure a section.
This section must be 25,000 cubits long.
It must be 10,000 cubits wide.
The sanctuary will be in this section.
The sanctuary is the Most Holy Place.
passages.original: וּמִן־ הַמִּדָּ֤ה הַזֹּאת֙ תָּמ֔וֹד אֹ֗רֶךְ חֲמֵשׁ וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְרֹ֖חַב עֲשֶׂ֣רֶת אֲלָפִ֑ים וּבֽוֹ־ יִהְיֶ֥ה הַמִּקְדָּ֖שׁ קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָדָשִֽׁים׃

passages.text: It will be a holy portion of the land to be used by the priests who minister in the sanctuary, who draw near to minister before the LORD. It will be a place for their houses, as well as a holy area for the sanctuary.
passages.sermon:
This land is a holy portion.
God sets it apart from the rest of the land.
The priests will use this land.
These priests serve in the sanctuary.
They come near to serve the LORD.
This land will give them a place for their houses.
This land will also have a holy area for the sanctuary.
passages.original: קֹ֣דֶשׁ מִן־ הָאָ֜רֶץ ה֗וּא לַכֹּ֨הֲנִ֜ים מְשָׁרְתֵ֤י הַמִּקְדָּשׁ֙ יִֽהְיֶ֔ה הַקְּרֵבִ֖ים לְשָׁרֵ֣ת אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה וְהָיָ֨ה לָהֶ֤ם מָקוֹם֙ לְבָ֣תִּ֔ים וּמִקְדָּ֖שׁ לַמִּקְדָּֽשׁ׃

passages.text: An adjacent area 25,000 cubits long and 10,000 cubits wide shall belong to the Levites who minister in the temple; it will be their possession for towns in which to live.
passages.sermon:
The Levites serve in the temple.
They will receive a piece of land.
This land will be 25,000 cubits long.
It will be 10,000 cubits wide.
This land will belong to them.
They will use it for their towns.
They will live in these towns.
passages.original: וַחֲמִשָּׁ֨ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֥ים אֶ֙לֶף֙ אֹ֔רֶךְ וַעֲשֶׂ֥רֶת אֲלָפִ֖ים רֹ֑חַב יִהְיֶה לַלְוִיִּם֩ מְשָׁרְתֵ֨י הַבַּ֧יִת לָהֶ֛ם לַאֲחֻזָּ֖ה עֶשְׂרִ֥ים לְשָׁכֹֽת׃

passages.text: As the property of the city, you are to set aside an area 5,000 cubits wide and 25,000 cubits long, adjacent to the holy district. It will belong to the whole house of Israel.
passages.sermon:
The city will have a special area of land.
This area will be 5,000 cubits wide.
It will be 25,000 cubits long.
This area will be next to the holy district.
All the people of Israel will own this area together.
passages.original: וַאֲחֻזַּ֨ת הָעִ֜יר תִּתְּנ֗וּ חֲמֵ֤שֶׁת אֲלָפִים֙ רֹ֔חַב וְאֹ֗רֶךְ חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְעֶשְׂרִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף לְעֻמַּ֖ת תְּרוּמַ֣ת הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ לְכָל־ בֵּ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יִהְיֶֽה׃

passages.text: Now the prince will have the area bordering each side of the area formed by the holy district and the property of the city, extending westward from the western side and eastward from the eastern side, running lengthwise from the western boundary to the eastern boundary and parallel to one of the tribal portions.
passages.sermon:
The prince of Israel will receive land.
This land will be next to the holy district and the city’s property.
The land will border both the holy district and the city’s property.
It will be on both the west side and the east side.
The land will stretch westward from the western boundary.
It will also stretch eastward from the eastern boundary.
The length of the land will run from the western border to the eastern border.
The land will be parallel to one of the tribal portions.
passages.original: וְלַנָּשִׂ֡יא מִזֶּ֣ה וּמִזֶּה֩ לִתְרוּמַ֨ת הַקֹּ֜דֶשׁ וְלַאֲחֻזַּ֣ת הָעִ֗יר אֶל־ פְּנֵ֤י תְרֽוּמַת־ הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ וְאֶל־ פְּנֵי֙ אֲחֻזַּ֣ת הָעִ֔יר מִפְּאַת־ יָ֣ם יָ֔מָּה וּמִפְּאַת־ קֵ֖דְמָה קָדִ֑ימָה וְאֹ֗רֶךְ לְעֻמּוֹת֙ אַחַ֣ד הַחֲלָקִ֔ים מִגְּב֥וּל יָ֖ם אֶל־ גְּב֥וּל קָדִֽימָה׃

passages.text: This land will be his possession in Israel. And My princes will no longer oppress My people, but will give the rest of the land to the house of Israel according to their tribes.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel.
God gave land to the prince as his possession in Israel.
God said the princes will not oppress His people anymore.
God commanded the princes to give the rest of the land to the house of Israel.
Each tribe of Israel will receive its share of the land.
passages.original: לָאָ֛רֶץ יִֽהְיֶה־ לּ֥וֹ לַֽאֲחֻזָּ֖ה בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹא־ יוֹנ֨וּ ע֤וֹד נְשִׂיאַי֙ אֶת־ עַמִּ֔י וְהָאָ֛רֶץ יִתְּנ֥וּ לְבֵֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְשִׁבְטֵיהֶֽם׃ס

passages.text: For this is what the Lord GOD says: ‘Enough, O princes of Israel! Cease your violence and oppression, and do what is just and right. Stop dispossessing My people, declares the Lord GOD.’
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He addresses the princes of Israel.
He says, "Enough."
He commands the princes to stop their violence.
He commands them to stop their oppression.
He tells them to do what is just.
He tells them to do what is right.
He commands them to stop taking land from His people.
The Lord GOD declares this.
passages.original: כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֞ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה רַב־ לָכֶם֙ נְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל חָמָ֤ס וָשֹׁד֙ הָסִ֔ירוּ וּמִשְׁפָּ֥ט וּצְדָקָ֖ה עֲשׂ֑וּ הָרִ֤ימוּ גְרֻשֹֽׁתֵיכֶם֙ מֵעַ֣ל עַמִּ֔י נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

passages.text: You must use honest scales, a just ephah, and a just bath.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God commands them to act with honesty.
You must use honest scales.
You must use a just ephah.
You must use a just bath.
God requires fairness in all your measurements.
passages.original: מֹֽאזְנֵי־ צֶ֧דֶק וְאֵֽיפַת־ צֶ֛דֶק וּבַת־ צֶ֖דֶק יְהִ֥י לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: The ephah and the bath shall be the same quantity so that the bath will contain a tenth of a homer, and the ephah a tenth of a homer; the homer will be the standard measure for both.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the leaders of Israel.
God gave them instructions about measurements.
The ephah is a unit for dry goods.
The bath is a unit for liquids.
The ephah and the bath must be equal in quantity.
Each must be one-tenth of a homer.
A homer is the standard measure for both.
Use the homer to set the amount for the ephah and the bath.
The bath will always be a tenth of a homer.
The ephah will always be a tenth of a homer.
passages.original: הָאֵיפָ֣ה וְהַבַּ֗ת תֹּ֤כֶן אֶחָד֙ יִֽהְיֶ֔ה לָשֵׂ֕את מַעְשַׂ֥ר הַחֹ֖מֶר הַבָּ֑ת וַעֲשִׂירִ֤ת הַחֹ֙מֶר֙ הָֽאֵיפָ֔ה אֶל־ הַחֹ֖מֶר יִהְיֶ֥ה מַתְכֻּנְתּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: The shekel will consist of twenty gerahs. Twenty shekels plus twenty-five shekels plus fifteen shekels will equal one mina.
passages.sermon:
A shekel is a unit of weight and money in ancient Israel.
One shekel equals twenty gerahs.
A mina is a larger unit of weight and money.
One mina equals sixty shekels.
You add twenty shekels, twenty-five shekels, and fifteen shekels to make one mina.
This is the standard for you.
passages.original: וְהַשֶּׁ֖קֶל עֶשְׂרִ֣ים גֵּרָ֑ה עֶשְׂרִ֨ים שְׁקָלִ֜ים חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וְעֶשְׂרִ֣ים שְׁקָלִ֗ים עֲשָׂרָ֤ה וַחֲמִשָּׁה֙ שֶׁ֔קֶל הַמָּנֶ֖ה יִֽהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: This is the contribution you are to offer: a sixth of an ephah from each homer of wheat, and a sixth of an ephah from each homer of barley.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions to the people of Israel.
He told them to bring a contribution.
Each person must offer a portion from their harvest.
From every homer of wheat, give one sixth of an ephah.
From every homer of barley, give one sixth of an ephah.
This is the required offering.
passages.original: זֹ֥את הַתְּרוּמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר תָּרִ֑ימוּ שִׁשִּׁ֤ית הָֽאֵיפָה֙ מֵחֹ֣מֶר הַֽחִטִּ֔ים וְשִׁשִּׁיתֶם֙ הָֽאֵיפָ֔ה מֵחֹ֖מֶר הַשְּׂעֹרִֽים׃

passages.text: The prescribed portion of oil, measured by the bath, is a tenth of a bath from each cor (a cor consists of ten baths or one homer, since ten baths are equivalent to a homer).
passages.sermon:
The law gives a rule about oil.
The people must measure oil using the bath.
Each person must give one tenth of a bath of oil from every cor.
One cor equals ten baths.
One cor also equals one homer.
Ten baths are the same as one homer.
passages.original: וְחֹ֨ק הַשֶּׁ֜מֶן הַבַּ֣ת הַשֶּׁ֗מֶן מַעְשַׂ֤ר הַבַּת֙ מִן־ הַכֹּ֔ר עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת הַבַּתִּ֖ים חֹ֑מֶר כִּֽי־ עֲשֶׂ֥רֶת הַבַּתִּ֖ים חֹֽמֶר׃

passages.text: And one sheep shall be given from each flock of two hundred from the well-watered pastures of Israel. These are for the grain offerings, burnt offerings, and peace offerings, to make atonement for the people, declares the Lord GOD.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He commands the people of Israel.
The people must give one sheep.
They must take this sheep from every flock of two hundred.
These flocks come from the well-watered pastures of Israel.
The people must use this sheep for offerings.
They must give it for a grain offering.
They must give it for a burnt offering.
They must give it for a peace offering.
These offerings make atonement for the people.
passages.original: וְשֶׂה־ אַחַ֨ת מִן־ הַצֹּ֤אן מִן־ הַמָּאתַ֙יִם֙ מִמַּשְׁקֵ֣ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְמִנְחָ֖ה וּלְעוֹלָ֣ה וְלִשְׁלָמִ֑ים לְכַפֵּ֣ר עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃

passages.text: All the people of the land must participate in this contribution for the prince in Israel.
passages.sermon: All the people live in the land of Israel.\r\nThey must give a contribution.\r\nThis contribution is for the prince in Israel.
passages.original: כֹּ֚ל הָעָ֣ם הָאָ֔רֶץ יִהְי֖וּ אֶל־ הַתְּרוּמָ֣ה הַזֹּ֑את לַנָּשִׂ֖יא בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And it shall be the prince’s part to provide the burnt offerings, grain offerings, and drink offerings for the feasts, New Moons, and Sabbaths—for all the appointed feasts of the house of Israel. He will provide the sin offerings, grain offerings, burnt offerings, and peace offerings to make atonement for the house of Israel.
passages.sermon:
The prince in Israel must provide offerings.
He must give burnt offerings.
He must give grain offerings.
He must give drink offerings.
He must do this at the feasts.
He must do this at the New Moons.
He must do this on the Sabbaths.
He must do this at all appointed times for the house of Israel.
The prince will give sin offerings.
He will give grain offerings.
He will give burnt offerings.
He will give peace offerings.
He will do this to make atonement for the house of Israel.
passages.original: וְעַֽל־ הַנָּשִׂ֣יא יִהְיֶ֗ה הָעוֹל֣וֹת וְהַמִּנְחָה֮ וְהַנֵּסֶךְ֒ בַּחַגִּ֤ים וּבֶחֳדָשִׁים֙ וּבַשַּׁבָּת֔וֹת בְּכָֽל־ מוֹעֲדֵ֖י בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל הֽוּא־ יַעֲשֶׂ֞ה אֶת־ הַחַטָּ֣את וְאֶת־ הַמִּנְחָ֗ה וְאֶת־ הָֽעוֹלָה֙ וְאֶת־ הַשְּׁלָמִ֔ים לְכַפֵּ֖ר בְּעַ֥ד בֵּֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

passages.text: This is what the Lord GOD says: ‘On the first day of the first month you are to take a young bull without blemish and purify the sanctuary.
passages.sermon:
The Lord GOD speaks.
He gives a command.
On the first day of the first month, you must act.
You must take a young bull.
The bull must have no blemish.
You must use the bull to purify the sanctuary.
passages.original: כֹּה־ אָמַר֮ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִה֒ בָּֽרִאשׁוֹן֙ בְּאֶחָ֣ד לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ תִּקַּ֥ח פַּר־ בֶּן־ בָּקָ֖ר תָּמִ֑ים וְחִטֵּאתָ֖ אֶת־ הַמִּקְדָּֽשׁ׃

passages.text: And the priest is to take some of the blood from the sin offering and put it on the doorposts of the temple, on the four corners of the ledge of the altar, and on the gateposts of the inner court.
passages.sermon:
The priest serves in the temple.
The priest takes some blood from the sin offering.
The priest puts the blood on the doorposts of the temple.
The priest puts the blood on the four corners of the ledge of the altar.
The priest puts the blood on the gateposts of the inner court.
passages.original: וְלָקַ֨ח הַכֹּהֵ֜ן מִדַּ֣ם הַחַטָּ֗את וְנָתַן֙ אֶל־ מְזוּזַ֣ת הַבַּ֔יִת וְאֶל־ אַרְבַּ֛ע פִּנּ֥וֹת הָעֲזָרָ֖ה לַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְעַ֨ל־ מְזוּזַ֔ת שַׁ֖עַר הֶחָצֵ֥ר הַפְּנִימִֽית׃

passages.text: You must do the same thing on the seventh day of the month for anyone who strays unintentionally or in ignorance. In this way you will make atonement for the temple.
passages.sermon:
God gives instructions to the people of Israel.
God commands them to purify the temple.
On the seventh day of the month, follow the same ritual as before.
Do this for anyone who sins by mistake.
Do this for anyone who sins because they do not know.
By doing this, you will make atonement for the temple.
passages.original: וְכֵ֤ן תַּֽעֲשֶׂה֙ בְּשִׁבְעָ֣ה בַחֹ֔דֶשׁ מֵאִ֥ישׁ שֹׁגֶ֖ה וּמִפֶּ֑תִי וְכִפַּרְתֶּ֖ם אֶת־ הַבָּֽיִת׃

passages.text: On the fourteenth day of the first month you are to observe the Passover, a feast of seven days, during which unleavened bread shall be eaten.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Israel to keep the Passover.
The Passover begins on the fourteenth day of the first month.
The Passover is a feast.
The feast lasts seven days.
During these seven days, you must eat unleavened bread.
passages.original: בָּ֠רִאשׁוֹן בְּאַרְבָּעָ֨ה עָשָׂ֥ר יוֹם֙ לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶ֖ם הַפָּ֑סַח חָ֕ג שְׁבֻע֣וֹת יָמִ֔ים מַצּ֖וֹת יֵאָכֵֽל׃

passages.text: On that day the prince shall provide a bull as a sin offering for himself and for all the people of the land.
passages.sermon:
The prince must act on that day.
He must provide a bull.
The bull is a sin offering.
The prince offers the bull for himself.
He also offers the bull for all the people of the land.
passages.original: וְעָשָׂ֤ה הַנָּשִׂיא֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא בַּעֲד֕וֹ וּבְעַ֖ד כָּל־ עַ֣ם הָאָ֑רֶץ פַּ֖ר חַטָּֽאת׃

passages.text: Each day during the seven days of the feast, he shall provide seven bulls and seven rams without blemish as a burnt offering to the LORD, along with a male goat for a sin offering.
passages.sermon:
The prince leads the people during the seven-day feast.
Each day of the feast, he gives offerings to the LORD.
He provides seven bulls each day.
He provides seven rams each day.
All the bulls and rams must be without blemish.
He offers these as burnt offerings to the LORD.
He also gives a male goat each day.
He offers the male goat as a sin offering.
passages.original: וְשִׁבְעַ֨ת יְמֵֽי־ הֶחָ֜ג יַעֲשֶׂ֧ה עוֹלָ֣ה לַֽיהוָ֗ה שִׁבְעַ֣ת פָּ֠רִים וְשִׁבְעַ֨ת אֵילִ֤ים תְּמִימִם֙ לַיּ֔וֹם שִׁבְעַ֖ת הַיָּמִ֑ים וְחַטָּ֕את שְׂעִ֥יר עִזִּ֖ים לַיּֽוֹם׃

passages.text: He shall also provide as a grain offering an ephah for each bull and an ephah for each ram, along with a hin of olive oil for each ephah of grain.
passages.sermon:
The prince must give a grain offering.
He must give one ephah of grain for each bull.
He must give one ephah of grain for each ram.
He must give one hin of oil for each ephah of grain.
passages.original: וּמִנְחָ֗ה אֵיפָ֥ה לַפָּ֛ר וְאֵיפָ֥ה לָאַ֖יִל יַֽעֲשֶׂ֑ה וְשֶׁ֖מֶן הִ֥ין לָאֵיפָֽה׃

passages.text: During the seven days of the feast that begins on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, he is to make the same provision for sin offerings, burnt offerings, grain offerings, and oil.’
passages.sermon:
The feast begins on the fifteenth day of the seventh month.
The feast lasts for seven days.
During these seven days, the leader must provide offerings.
He must give sin offerings each day.
He must give burnt offerings each day.
He must give grain offerings each day.
He must give oil each day.
He must do this every day of the seven days of the feast.
He must provide these offerings in the same way each day.
passages.original: בַּשְּׁבִיעִ֡י בַּחֲמִשָּׁה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֤וֹם לַחֹ֙דֶשׁ֙ בֶּחָ֔ג יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה כָאֵ֖לֶּה שִׁבְעַ֣ת הַיָּמִ֑ים כַּֽחַטָּאת֙ כָּעֹלָ֔ה וְכַמִּנְחָ֖ה וְכַשָּֽׁמֶן׃ס
